title: 首爾清溪川復育~Seoul Cheonggyecheon restoration
focus: 城市河川復育的水、能源與公共效益~Water, energy and public benefits of urban-stream restoration
summary: 清溪川復育把水路帶回都市，也需要維持用水與公共管理。本課由集水與基流走到水力、能源、遮蔭和生態證據，分開評估景觀與河川功能。~Cheonggyecheon returned a water corridor to the city while requiring maintenance water and public management. Follow catchment and baseflow through hydraulics, energy, shade and ecological evidence, separating appearance from function.

units.title: 城市集水區與暴雨邊界：集水面積與逕流量~Urban catchment and storm boundary: Catchment area and runoff volume
units.mechanism: 降雨量乘面積提供總水量，以逕流係數近似扣除入滲與其他損失；該係數隨土壤與前期濕度而變。本單元在「城市集水區與暴雨邊界」觀察此因果關係。~Rain depth times area gives total water; a runoff coefficient approximates infiltration and other losses and varies with soil and antecedent moisture. Examine this relationship at urban catchment and storm boundary.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：雨深P=30 mm、集水面積A=10000 m²、C=0.75。公式 V=CPA/1000；代入 0.75*30*10000/1000 = 225 m³。適用邊界：事件總量近似，不能推得尖峰流率或管線容量。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: rainP=30 mm, catchmentA=10000 m² andC=0.75. Formula V=CPA/1000; substitution 0.75*30*10000/1000 = 225 m³. Boundary: Event-volume approximation; does not predict peak flow or pipe capacity.
units.verify: 畫屋頂、路面與綠地分區，分別加權C並核對雨量站。在離線場景為「城市集水區與暴雨邊界」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Map roofs, pavement and vegetation, weight C separately and check rainfall data. Build an offline evidence table for urban catchment and storm boundary; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 把mm直接乘m²而未除1000會造成千倍錯誤。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Multiplying mm bym² without dividing by1000 gives a thousandfold error. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 總雨量相同就保證尖峰淹水風險相同。~Equal storm totals guarantee equal peak flood risk.
units.practice: 先點選「城市集水區與暴雨邊界」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把C降成0.50，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 150 m³。與基準 225 m³比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the urban catchment and storm boundary measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only C to0.50 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 150 m³. Compare with baseline 225 m³ and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 維持用水來源配對：回用水混合與需求配對~Maintenance-water source matching: Reuse blending and demand matching
units.mechanism: 混合濃度由各水流的質量加權，而不是簡單平均；不同用途的需求與品質應分別核對。本單元在「維持用水來源配對」觀察此因果關係。~Blended concentration is mass weighted rather than a simple average; quality and demand must be checked separately for each reuse. Examine this relationship at maintenance-water source matching.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Q1=80、Q2=20 m³/h；C1=5、C2=100 mg/L。公式 Cmix=(Q1C1+Q2C2)/(Q1+Q2)；代入 (80*5+20*100)/(80+20) = 24 mg/L。適用邊界：同一可加成保守溶質；微生物風險與化學相容性不能僅靠此式判斷。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Q1=80 and Q2=20 m³/h; C1=5 and C2=100 mg/L. Formula Cmix=(Q1C1+Q2C2)/(Q1+Q2); substitution (80*5+20*100)/(80+20) = 24 mg/L. Boundary: One additive conservative solute; microbial risk and chemical compatibility cannot be established by this formula.
units.verify: 檢查流量權重與採樣位置，再用混合後樣品驗證。在離線場景為「維持用水來源配對」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Inspect flow weights and sampling locations and verify with a downstream mixed sample. Build an offline evidence table for maintenance-water source matching; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 混合未完全就採樣會得到隨位置不同的濃度。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Sampling before complete mixing yields position-dependent concentrations. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 兩股不同流量的濃度總可直接取平均。~Concentrations of unequal flows can always be averaged directly.
units.practice: 先點選「維持用水來源配對」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把Q2改成40 m³/h，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 36.66667 mg/L。與基準 24 mg/L比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the maintenance-water source matching measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only Q2 to40 m³/h with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 36.66667 mg/L. Compare with baseline 24 mg/L and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 溪床斷面與人行空間：流速與通水斷面~Channel section and pedestrian space: Velocity and flow area
units.mechanism: 連續方程 Q=Av 將流量連到平均流速；局部收縮與阻塞提高流速及水頭損失。本單元在「溪床斷面與人行空間」觀察此因果關係。~Continuity Q=Av links discharge to mean velocity; local contraction and blockage increase velocity and head loss. Examine this relationship at channel section and pedestrian space.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：流量 Q=0.9 m³/s、有效面積 A=0.6 m²。公式 v=Q/A；代入 0.9/0.6 = 1.5 m/s。適用邊界：均勻平均流；不能用平均流速判定局部沖刷或人員安全。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: flow Q=0.9 m³/s and clear area A=0.6 m². Formula v=Q/A; substitution 0.9/0.6 = 1.5 m/s. Boundary: Uniform mean flow; local scour or human safety cannot be inferred from mean velocity alone.
units.verify: 比較水位、流量與有效面積，再以斷面多點量測查偏流。在離線場景為「溪床斷面與人行空間」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Compare level, flow and clear area, then inspect nonuniformity with multiple section measurements. Build an offline evidence table for channel section and pedestrian space; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 只使用名目斷面會忽略攔污物或沉積造成的縮減。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Nominal area misses reductions caused by debris or sediment. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 阻塞不會改變同一流量下的流速。~Blockage cannot change velocity at the same flow.
units.practice: 先點選「溪床斷面與人行空間」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把有效面積減至0.45 m²，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 2 m/s。與基準 1.5 m/s比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the channel section and pedestrian space measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only clear area to0.45 m² with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 2 m/s. Compare with baseline 1.5 m/s and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 橋梁間水路粗糙度：重力輸送與粗糙度~Between-bridge channel roughness: Gravity conveyance and roughness
units.mechanism: Manning 模型以水力半徑、坡度與粗糙度表示明渠平均輸送能力；加粗表面會降低同水位的流量。本單元在「橋梁間水路粗糙度」觀察此因果關係。~The Manning model relates open-channel capacity to hydraulic radius, slope and roughness; greater roughness reduces discharge at the same depth. Examine this relationship at between-bridge channel roughness.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：A=4 m²、R=0.8 m、S=0.001、n=0.015。公式 Q=(A/n)R^(2/3)S^(1/2)；代入 (4/0.015)*0.8**(2/3)*0.001**0.5 = 7.267115 m³/s。適用邊界：穩定均勻明渠近似；滿管壓力、回水與跌水需另建模。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: A=4 m², R=0.8 m, S=0.001 and n=0.015. Formula Q=(A/n)R^(2/3)S^(1/2); substitution (4/0.015)*0.8**(2/3)*0.001**0.5 = 7.267115 m³/s. Boundary: Steady uniform open-channel approximation; pressure flow, backwater and drops require separate models.
units.verify: 量測縱坡與斷面，校準不同水位的流量曲線。在離線場景為「橋梁間水路粗糙度」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Measure slope and section and calibrate the discharge curve at several depths. Build an offline evidence table for between-bridge channel roughness; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 沉積與生物膜改變粗糙度，沿用初建值可能高估能力。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Sediment and biofilm alter roughness; an as-built value may overestimate capacity. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 同一斷面輸送能力與粗糙度無關。~Capacity of the same section is independent of roughness.
units.practice: 先點選「橋梁間水路粗糙度」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把 n 改成0.020，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 5.450337 m³/s。與基準 7.267115 m³/s比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the between-bridge channel roughness measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only n to0.020 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 5.450337 m³/s. Compare with baseline 7.267115 m³/s and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 補注供水能源帳：提升水頭與電力~Maintenance-supply energy ledger: Lift head and electrical power
units.mechanism: 泵的輸入功率須供應流量的位能增加及損失；效率下降會使同一輸送服務耗電增加。本單元在「補注供水能源帳」觀察此因果關係。~Pump input must provide the hydraulic energy increase and losses; lower efficiency increases electricity for the same conveyance service. Examine this relationship at maintenance-supply energy ledger.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Q=0.10 m³/s、H=12 m、總效率η=0.72、ρ=1000 kg/m³。公式 P=ρgQH/(1000η)；代入 1000*9.81*0.10*12/(1000*0.72) = 16.35 kW。適用邊界：穩態不可壓縮流，H含管損；不涵蓋起動、水錘與汽蝕。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Q=0.10 m³/s, H=12 m, total efficiencyη=0.72 and ρ=1000 kg/m³. Formula P=ρgQH/(1000η); substitution 1000*9.81*0.10*12/(1000*0.72) = 16.35 kW. Boundary: Steady incompressible flow with friction included in H; starting, surge and cavitation are excluded.
units.verify: 同步量測流量、進出口壓差與真實功率，勿把視在功率當耗電。在離線場景為「補注供水能源帳」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Synchronize flow, pressure difference and real-power measurements; do not confuse apparent and real power. Build an offline evidence table for maintenance-supply energy ledger; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 葉輪磨損或閥門節流會改變工作點，須查泵曲線。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Impeller wear or throttling changes the operating point; inspect the pump curve. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 相同流量下所有泵的耗電都相同。~All pumps consume the same power at equal flow.
units.practice: 先點選「補注供水能源帳」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把效率降成0.60，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 19.62 kW。與基準 16.35 kW比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the maintenance-supply energy ledger measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only efficiency to0.60 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 19.62 kW. Compare with baseline 16.35 kW and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 沿岸遮蔭樣區：遮蔭與表面熱收支~Riverside shade plots: Shade and surface heat balance
units.mechanism: 遮蔭減少短波吸收，但人體熱感還受到風、長波輻射與濕度影響。本單元在「沿岸遮蔭樣區」觀察此因果關係。~Shade reduces absorbed shortwave radiation, while human thermal sensation also depends on wind, longwave radiation and humidity. Examine this relationship at riverside shade plots.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：面積100 m²、入射600 W/m²、吸收率0.70、遮蔭減少入射0.60。公式 ΔP=A I α fshade/1000；代入 100*600*0.70*0.60/1000 = 25.2 kW。適用邊界：單一表面瞬時短波示範，不直接預測氣溫或體感溫度。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: area100 m², irradiance600 W/m², absorptivity0.70 and shade reduction0.60. Formula ΔP=A I α fshade/1000; substitution 100*600*0.70*0.60/1000 = 25.2 kW. Boundary: Instantaneous shortwave balance of one surface; not an air or perceived-temperature prediction.
units.verify: 同時量測陰陽面表面溫度、輻射與風，採相同時段對照。在離線場景為「沿岸遮蔭樣區」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Measure shaded/unshaded surface temperature, radiation and wind concurrently. Build an offline evidence table for riverside shade plots; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 只用紅外線表面溫度宣稱人體降溫會混淆指標。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Claiming human cooling from infrared surface temperature alone confuses indicators. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 路面降溫數字可以直接當作人體感覺降溫。~Pavement cooling equals perceived human cooling.
units.practice: 先點選「沿岸遮蔭樣區」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把遮蔭比例提高至0.80，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 33.6 kW。與基準 25.2 kW比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the riverside shade plots measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only shade reduction to0.80 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 33.6 kW. Compare with baseline 25.2 kW and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 狹長河岸棲地：生態廊道與可用棲地~Linear riparian habitat: Ecological corridors and usable habitat
units.mechanism: 綠地面積與真正連通的可用棲地不同；硬質障礙、照明與維護方式影響動植物通行。本單元在「狹長河岸棲地」觀察此因果關係。~Green area differs from connected usable habitat; hard barriers, lighting and maintenance affect movement. Examine this relationship at linear riparian habitat.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：廊道長800 m、平均有效寬度12 m。公式 A=Lw；代入 800*12 = 9600 m²。適用邊界：幾何面積近似，不是物種存活率或生態服務價值。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: corridor length800 m and mean effective width12 m. Formula A=Lw; substitution 800*12 = 9600 m². Boundary: Geometric-area approximation, not survival probability or ecosystem-service valuation.
units.verify: 在地圖標斷點，搭配定點觀察確認指定物種是否實際使用。在離線場景為「狹長河岸棲地」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Map breaks and use fixed observations to verify use by specified species. Build an offline evidence table for linear riparian habitat; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 廊道被道路切斷時，相同面積仍可能失去連通。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~A road break can destroy connectivity despite unchanged area. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 只要綠地面積增加，所有物種都會受益。~More green area benefits every species.
units.practice: 先點選「狹長河岸棲地」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把有效寬度減成8 m，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 6400 m²。與基準 9600 m²比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the linear riparian habitat measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only effective width to8 m with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 6400 m². Compare with baseline 9600 m² and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 物種與季節調查：棲地樣區與多樣性指標~Species and seasonal surveys: Habitat plots and diversity indicators
units.mechanism: Simpson多樣性以物種比例衡量優勢程度；指標增加不等於所有原生物種都恢復。本單元在「物種與季節調查」觀察此因果關係。~Simpson diversity measures dominance through species proportions; a larger index does not prove recovery of every native species. Examine this relationship at species and seasonal surveys.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：四類生物比例0.4、0.3、0.2、0.1。公式 D=1-Σpi²；代入 1-(0.4**2+0.3**2+0.2**2+0.1**2) = 0.7 index。適用邊界：相同採樣方法與努力量；不替代保育物種與外來種調查。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: four taxon proportions0.4,0.3,0.2,0.1. Formula D=1-Σpi²; substitution 1-(0.4**2+0.3**2+0.2**2+0.1**2) = 0.7 index. Boundary: Same sampling method and effort; not a replacement for protected- and invasive-species surveys.
units.verify: 固定樣區、季節與採樣時長，另記棲地連續性與外來種。在離線場景為「物種與季節調查」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Fix plots, season and effort and separately record connectivity and invasive species. Build an offline evidence table for species and seasonal surveys; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 採樣努力量增加會製造看似改善，須對照基線。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Greater sampling effort can mimic improvement; compare with the baseline. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 看到更多物種就可以忽略是否為入侵物種。~More observed species makes invasive status irrelevant.
units.practice: 先點選「物種與季節調查」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把分布改成四類各0.25，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 0.75 index。與基準 0.7 index比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the species and seasonal surveys measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only proportions to four equal0.25 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 0.75 index. Compare with baseline 0.7 index and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 水位水質監測對照：感測器偏移校正~Level/quality sensor comparison: Sensor offset calibration
units.mechanism: 參考標準可辨識偏移；一點校正只能處理固定偏移，斜率誤差須多點標準確認。本單元在「水位水質監測對照」觀察此因果關係。~A reference reveals offset; one-point correction handles only a constant offset, whereas gain error needs several standards. Examine this relationship at level/quality sensor comparison.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：參考值10.0、感測器10.8、樣品原讀值14.2，單位一致。公式 Ccorrected=Craw-(Cstandard_read-Creference)；代入 14.2-(10.8-10.0) = 13.4 sensor unit。適用邊界：假設偏移固定且量程線性；不代替多點校正與漂移追蹤。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: reference10.0, sensor10.8 and raw sample14.2 in the same units. Formula Ccorrected=Craw-(Cstandard_read-Creference); substitution 14.2-(10.8-10.0) = 13.4 sensor unit. Boundary: Constant offset and linear range assumed; multi-point calibration and drift tracking remain necessary.
units.verify: 用第二標準獨立驗證校正後殘差並記錄日期與溫度。在離線場景為「水位水質監測對照」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Use a second standard to verify corrected residuals independently and record date and temperature. Build an offline evidence table for level/quality sensor comparison; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 以同一標準建立又驗證模型會隱藏校正偏差。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Calibrating and validating with the same standard hides bias. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 單點校正可以證明整個量程都沒有誤差。~One-point calibration proves the entire range is error-free.
units.practice: 先點選「水位水質監測對照」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把樣品原讀值改成16.2，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 15.4 sensor unit。與基準 13.4 sensor unit比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the level/quality sensor comparison measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only raw sample to16.2 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 15.4 sensor unit. Compare with baseline 13.4 sensor unit and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 復育前後與對照街區：前後與對照地點比較~Before-after and control streets: Before-after and control comparison
units.mechanism: 干預前後差異還可能包含天氣與背景趨勢；前後—對照差分可分離共同變化但仍須檢查可比性。本單元在「復育前後與對照街區」觀察此因果關係。~Before-after changes include weather and background trends; difference-in-differences removes common changes but still needs comparable sites. Examine this relationship at before-after and control streets.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：處理地由30降至27，對照地由29降至28，同一指標。公式 effect=(Tafter-Tbefore)-(Cafter-Cbefore)；代入 (27-30)-(28-29) = -2 indicator unit。適用邊界：假設共同背景趨勢；不是隨機試驗或完全因果證明。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: treated site30 to27 and control site29 to28 for the same indicator. Formula effect=(Tafter-Tbefore)-(Cafter-Cbefore); substitution (27-30)-(28-29) = -2 indicator unit. Boundary: Common background trend assumed; not a randomized trial or complete causal proof.
units.verify: 採同期多日資料並檢查前期趨勢，不選只對結果有利的一天。在離線場景為「復育前後與對照街區」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Use simultaneous multi-day data, inspect pre-trends and avoid selecting a favorable day. Build an offline evidence table for before-after and control streets; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 處理地同時換交通流量會讓單一干預歸因失真。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Concurrent traffic changes at the treated site confound attribution. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 前後改變全都必定由這一項工程造成。~Every before-after change must be caused by this project.
units.practice: 先點選「復育前後與對照街區」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把對照地事後值改成27，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 -1 indicator unit。與基準 -2 indicator unit比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the before-after and control streets measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only control-after to27 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute -1 indicator unit. Compare with baseline -2 indicator unit and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.
